A_inherited_from_epoch1_and_R1.statement: Epoch-1 qualification failed V3 and V6; the pooled mean was dominated by two blocks in which a C2 self-product left its calibration range.
R1 tested and refuted the operational-state hypothesis and localized the defect to P_rec, with no instantiated SIR object invalidated.
A_inherited_from_epoch1_and_R1.implication: K2 is a contract-hardening stage, not an object reconciliation

B_predictor_only_K2_findings.statement: gasa..gasd are gas injection valve COMMAND signals in volts. The upstream per-shot metadata records the unit string literally as 'volt' on 51/62 shots (gasa-c) and 62/62 (gasd). The provider manifest's Torr*L/s / gas_flow entry is a superseded first-pass external-convention hypothesis at LOW confidence with an AMBIGUOUS dimensional signature and NOT_TESTED magnitude.
B_predictor_only_K2_findings.implication: GAS_SIGNAL_UNIT_RESOLVED_COMMAND_VOLTAGE; the frozen (V)*(V) dimension on PROD(gasa,gasa) is CORRECT and the R1 concern is withdrawn

B_predictor_only_K2_findings.statement: Over all 10,778 atoms x 186 cells there are ZERO non-finite coordinate-cells, so the existing denominator condition is not the binding constraint anywhere in the atomic universe.
B_predictor_only_K2_findings.implication: range support is a genuinely distinct condition, not a restatement of denominator admissibility

B_predictor_only_K2_findings.statement: Hull excess over calibration RANGE is markedly more constructor-neutral than hull excess over calibration RMS: p90 spread ratio 4.3 across the seven families versus 35.1. RMS-normalisation systematically penalises rate-bearing families whose calibration mean sits near zero.
B_predictor_only_K2_findings.implication: metric R1 selected on desideratum D6

B_predictor_only_K2_findings.statement: At tau=1, 3,451 of 10,778 atoms (32.0 percent) retain full-domain range support across all 62 discharges, spanning all seven populated constructor families. Because the support predicate is a conjunction over the same cells, any combination of full-domain coordinates is automatically a full-domain support.
B_predictor_only_K2_findings.implication: Epoch-2 search space remains ~1e34 size-12 full-domain supports; the rule is neither vacuous nor over-restrictive

B_predictor_only_K2_findings.statement: None of the 217 Epoch-1 bootstrap-winning supports is full-domain at tau <= 1, and C_dev_star has only 6 of 12 coordinates individually full-domain.
B_predictor_only_K2_findings.implication: expected: that frontier was searched under a utility with no range-support pressure. It is ALSO direct evidence that tau was not outcome-tuned, since the chosen threshold is maximally unfavourable to every Epoch-1 object

C_normative_contract_decisions.statement: P_rec gains P-RANGE-SUPPORT with tau=1, separate from and additional to DENOMINATOR_ADMISSIBILITY_PRIMARY_V1.
C_normative_contract_decisions.implication: the minimal contract revision R1 predicted

C_normative_contract_decisions.statement: V_rec gains V-RANGE, a coverage gate only. It adds no performance threshold and does not modify V3-V10.
A_rec keeps locally unsupported coordinates; applicability is LOCAL and the coverage requirement lives in search and qualification.
C_normative_contract_decisions.implication: preserves SIR partial-map semantics and an expressive ontology
